criteria.evidence: internal/config/config.go adds the three Keys with Valid true/false, sonnet default and efforts; list tests in internal/cli/config_test.go and cmd/vloop/e2e_test.go show them; TestVerifyKeys asserts InvalidValueError for bad values

criteria.criterion: schemas/verify.v1.json defines verify/v1: `schema`, `findings` (each `{kind, claim, observed, where}`, kind one of `example`, `contract`, `surface`, all four required strings), `checked` (`{example_lines, sentences, surfaces}`, integers) and `notes`; `vloop schema list` lists it and `vloop schema validate verify/v1` accepts a valid report and rejects one that breaks any of those rules.
criteria.evidence: schemas/verify.v1.json matches the shape; schema list tests updated; valid/invalid fixtures in internal/schema/testdata, invalid expected at /findings/0/kind

criteria.criterion: schemas/session.v2.json's phase gains `verify`, which, like plan and gate-review, has no task; no schema version changes and existing records stay valid.
criteria.evidence: session.v2.json enum and if-clause include verify; TestSessionV2VerifyHasNoTask covers valid without task and invalid with task

criteria.evidence: existing enumerations only gain the three keys / verify/v1; go check log passes. internal/config/config_test.go also gains a new additive TestVerifyKeys, slightly beyond the literal wording but loosens nothing

notes: TestVerifyKeys was added to internal/config/config_test.go though the brief said that file changes only where it enumerates keys; additive, not a goalpost move, so not failed. The exit 2 of config set is tested only at the config package level.
